github: Connect GitHub and work with the bound repository.
github actions: Run, watch and read GitHub Actions workflows.
github actions commit: Read workflow runs for one commit.
github actions commit runs: Read workflow runs for one commit.
github actions commit runs list: List every workflow run for one commit.
github actions dispatch: Manage workflow dispatch records and tags.
github actions dispatch receipt: Read records of workflow dispatch requests.
github actions dispatch receipt get: Show the inputs and run for one dispatch request.
github actions dispatch tag: Manage tags that deployment runs dispatch at.
github actions dispatch tag ensure: Create or confirm a deployment dispatch tag.
github actions poll: Wait for one workflow run to finish.
github actions runners status: Show self-hosted runners and their routing.
github actions secret: Set or delete repository Actions secrets.
github actions secret set: Create or update one repository Actions secret.
github actions trigger: Start a workflow run, or find the one already started.
github actions variable: Read, set or delete repository Actions variables.
github actions variable set: Create or update one repository Actions variable.
github actions wait: Wait for a workflow run to finish.
github actions workflow: Start workflow runs and find them.
github actions workflow dispatch: Start a workflow run, or find the one already started.
github branch: Read branches of the bound repository.
github branch head: Show the commit a branch points to now.
github connect: Authorize this machine with the Yoke GitHub App.
github credential-helper: Manage the git credential helper Yoke installs.
github credential-helper refresh: Rebuild the git credential helper if it is missing.
github disconnect: Remove this machine's GitHub App authorization.
github merge queue: Set up the merge queue and hold queued items.
github merge queue apply: Apply the declared merge queue rules to the repository.
github merge queue hold: Take an item's pull request out of the merge queue.
github merge queue readiness: Show an item's pull request and its queue entry.
github merge-queue: Set up the merge queue and hold queued items.
github merge-queue apply: Apply the declared merge queue rules to the repository.
github merge-queue hold: Take an item's pull request out of the merge queue.
github merge-queue readiness: Show an item's pull request and its queue entry.
github open: Read open issues and pull requests.
github open work: Read open issues and pull requests.
github open work list: List the repository's open issues and pull requests.
github open-work: Read open issues and pull requests.
github open-work list: List the repository's open issues and pull requests.
github release create-commit-tag: Create the dated release tag for a release commit.
github status: Show whether this machine's GitHub access works.
